# Artemis Leonardou

> Full stack engineer, DevRel, public speaker, and tech content creator based in Athens. Building products, speaking about AI agents in production, and teaching people to build with AI.

Artemis Leonardou (known online as Artemis Codes, @artemis.codes) is a 19-year-old engineer, public speaker, and content creator. She is a Software Engineer and DevRel at NOFire AI and an Informatics student at NKUA (Top 1%). Her main Instagram (@artemis.codes) has 590k+ monthly views and 8k followers, growing rapidly.

## What she does

- **Builds**: Full stack web applications, AI-integrated products, mobile apps (Python/Django, Next.js, React Native)
- **Speaks**: Conference talks and workshops on AI agents in production, AI-assisted development, and Gen Z builder culture
- **Creates**: Short-form tech content on TikTok and Instagram covering AI tools, vibe coding, and practical AI builder tutorials
- **DevRel**: Developer Relations at NOFire AI, building the Context and Control Model for production

## Creator profile

- Instagram: @artemis.codes (main account, 590k+ monthly views, 8k followers)
- TikTok: @artemis.codes
- YouTube: @artemiscodes
- Audience: Tier-1 (US, EU, AU, CA) tech and builder audience
- Content style: fast-paced, educational, practical — shows real builds with real prompts
- Brand experience: NOFire AI, Intel (Student Ambassador)

## Developer profile

- Current role: Software Engineer and DevRel at NOFire AI (May 2026 - present), the Context and Control Model for production
- Previously: AI Product Developer / Founding Engineer at KanoParty (Jul 2025 - May 2026)
- Education: Informatics, NKUA (National and Kapodistrian University of Athens), Top 1%
- Credentials: 10+ hackathons, several first-place finishes; selected as one of roughly 3,000 students worldwide for Y Combinator's first AI Startup School (San Francisco, Jun 2025), which featured talks from Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Andrej Karpathy and Fei-Fei Li
- Stack: Python, Django, Next.js, React Native, PostgreSQL, Tailwind, Supabase

Available for conference talks and workshops. Topics: AI agents and production safety, what breaks when AI writes your code, guardrails for autonomous systems (blast radius, reversibility, policy before execution), vibe coding to production engineering, and building as a Gen Z engineer.
